name: Farmstead & Barn
description: A barn, a yard of churned mud and ploughed fields running to a fence.
palette: weathered barn timber, straw gold, wet earth brown, crop green
lighting: low golden evening light, long shadows across the furrows
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, carefully shaded volumetric detail, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: churned muddy yard giving way to ploughed furrows and stubble
materials: A fantasy farmstead seen from above. A large timber barn with its roof removed showing stalls, a hay loft and stacked bales inside, a yard of churned mud rutted by cartwheels, a farmhouse with a stone hearth and a plank table, ploughed fields running away in straight furrows to a post-and-rail fence, a stone well with a bucket, a hay wain half loaded, scattered feed sacks and a leaning scarecrow post, a vegetable plot in neat rows, an orchard of low fruit trees seen from above.
